name: Omega-3 fatty acids (EPA/DHA)

typical_dose_shape.note: No FDA-approved dosing reference exists for this compound. This range describes reported use and is not a recommendation.

description: Eicosapentaenoic and docosahexaenoic acid, marine-derived long-chain omega-3 fatty acids, sold as dietary supplements. Purified prescription forms exist separately with approved indications for hypertriglyceridaemia.

systems.note: Triglyceride reduction and membrane fatty acid modification; the intended effect and the basis of the prescription forms.
Prolonged bleeding time at higher intakes; atrial fibrillation signal in the prescription-dose trials.

monitors.why: The effect the supplement is taken for.
The direct membrane-incorporation index of intake.
Prolonged bleeding time at higher intakes.
